content: The second baseline is a sliding window approach that looks at windows of INLINEFORM0 tokens on the text. Each text and each answer are represented as a sequence of word embeddings. The embeddings for each window of size INLINEFORM1 and each answer are then averaged to derive window and answer representations, respectively. The answer with the lowest cosine distance to one of the windows of the text is then selected as correct.
